commit_message:
ANDROID: KVM: Prevent memory sharing outside of the RAM regions

Verify the address to be shared and prevent MMIO page
sharing. Allow MMIO to be donated to the hypervisor and
to the guest for device assignment.

Bug: 439996285
Signed-off-by: Sebastian Ene <sebastianene@google.com>
